text: There was one old maid she started knockin'. She walked right up and picked her suckin'. For you know you had a show, Missouri Joe. Was in the second sleeping car, Joe had a little fun. A fresh conductor, he came in and tried to raise a moth. Joe shot twelve bullets into his head.
